name: Sayonara.
source:
People always die in this world upon getting 20 years old. Only 19-year old people are left in this world as new children stopped being born. Main character lives among this last generation of humans, has his part of joy and sorrow and accepts fate peacefully. Can you say your farewells with a smile?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这个世界上的人一到20岁便会死去。新的孩子已经不再出生，世间只剩下19岁的人。主人公生活在人类最后一代之中，经历属于自己的喜悦与悲伤，平静地接受命运。你能面带微笑说出最后的告别吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
